evidence.observation: Growth held at ~750 °C with only a small initial overshoot settling by t≈2700 s
Flow tracks setpoints (100 sccm growth, 200 sccm cooldown)
Stable ~3.0 Torr in growth, ~4.0 Torr at higher purge flow
Exhaust O2 stays low (2-7 ppm), no leak signature
Heater power drops to ~0% at cooldown with smooth monotonic temperature decay

args.missing_evidence: Post-run characterization (e.g., Raman/optical/AFM) of the sample to determine whether the target film grew.
